image_description: A high-angle, eye-level shot of an ornate stone altar in a church sanctuary. The altar features a white marble top slab draped with a white cloth on the right side, supported by a heavily carved golden-brown stone base with intricate relief patterns. Behind the altar is a wooden reredos with Gothic-style tracery and three stained-glass windows. A bronze tabernacle sits on the center of the altar, flanked by tall candlesticks.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The bottom right corner of the altar base seems to merge indistinctly with the floor tiles. The shadow is soft and undefined, and the geometric line of the plinth blurs into the carpet/stone pattern, suggesting a slight grounding error.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The lead lines in the stained glass windows show minor waviness and inconsistency in thickness, lacking the rigid straightness expected of real architectural glasswork, though this is subtle.

focus_areas: Sharpness and logical consistency of the relief carvings on the altar front.
Geometric integrity of the altar's contact point with the floor (shadow and edge definition).
Structural plausibility of the tabernacle and candlesticks (do they stand firmly?).
Consistency of perspective lines in the background architecture (windows and reredos).
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'mushiness' of the carved details. In real stone carving, edges are sharp even if weathered. AI often smears these details. Also, verify if the shadow under the altar is consistent with the light coming from the windows; inconsistent shadows can indicate compositing or generation errors.
